deepdive.sec: Education / International Student Advisory & Campus Expansion

bull_bear.body: Prioritizing geographic expansion (Dubai, Paris, Africa, Nepal, Pakistan) over buybacks or debt reduction; reinvesting in brand building and campus setup
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Further visa policy tightening in key markets (Canada, UK, Germany); delay in Dubai/Paris licensing; slower-than-expected student conversion post-campuses launch; reliance on university commissions; macroeconomic headwinds affecting education loans
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Cautious on current H1FY26 performance but highly confident and excited about near-term campus launches; framing slowdown as temporary, not structural; strong emphasis on brand repositioning from 'immigration' to 'global education'
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Dubai campus licensing is imminent (expected within 2 weeks of call date); management has hired a global strategy director with 26+ years’ experience specifically to execute this expansion; campus model allows third-party agent sourcing, reducing dependency on own recruitment
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Canada: ~70% of revenue; UK and Germany: growing from <10% to significant share; Revenue model: primarily commissions from universities; minimal student fees
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tighter visa policies and deferred enrollments | Other Indian education consultancies without global campus presence | loser | High | Landmark's campus expansion creates a moat; competitors lack physical presence in key hubs like Dubai/Paris |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body: Margin compression due to fixed cost absorption on lower revenue + aggressive branch expansion (5 new branches) + sponsorship of international education fairs (APAIE, PAL, ICEF); Opex per campus not quantified but asset-light
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue growth: FY26 flat vs FY25; FY27 target INR80-90cr; Margin: FY27 PAT margin target 20-25%; Order inflow: not specified; Capex/commissioning: Dubai campus to launch Q4FY26, Paris campus Q1FY27, asset-light (rental model)
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Expansion into Bangladesh (live), Africa, Nepal, Pakistan; Dubai and Paris campuses to enable direct institutional partnerships and third-party agent sourcing; potential to monetize curriculum licensing
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: H1FY26 revenue declined due to deferred enrollments and tighter global visa policies, but management is aggressively expanding into Dubai and Paris campuses with near-term licensing imminent, positioning for revenue recovery and margin expansion in FY27-28.

meta.thesis: H1FY26 revenue declined due to deferred enrollments and tighter global visa policies, but management is aggressively expanding into Dubai and Paris campuses with near-term licensing imminent, positioning for revenue recovery and margin expansion in FY27-28.
